newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firms buy 35,000 tns U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firms buy 35,000 tns U.S. wheat.

text.p: Two Philippine firms bought 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for March shipment, Manila grains traders said on Friday.
The two companies clinched the contract with the local subsidiary of U.S. trading giant Cargill Inc late on Wednesday, traders said.

The traders said the Philippine firms bought 8,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content and 7,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a 13.5 percent protein content. "Average price for both grades of wheat is more than $180 per tonne FOB," said one trader.
The two companies also bought 20,000 tonnes of western white wheat at $156 to $158 per tonne FOB, they added.
